summary.goal: When a user answers an MCP question, broadcast the Q&A to the plan channel with distinctive styling so all participants see the decision made.
in_scope: Post Q&A to #plan-{id} channel when question is answered
Include: question text, answer text, agent name, timestamp
Special card styling distinct from normal chat messages
summary.approach: Use existing message `data` field with type='qa' payload. Frontend detects data.type and renders QAMessageCard component instead of standard message bubble.

acceptance_criteria.description: Answering a question via TriagePanel/ChatBubble sends a message to #plan-{id} channel
Q&A message contains question text, answer text, agent name (who asked), and timestamp
Q&A messages render with distinct card styling (different background, icon, layout) vs normal chat
Q&A messages appear in MessagingSidebar message stream when viewing that plan
Q&A messages appear in /channels/:id view for the plan channel
Q&A card shows blocking level badge (hard_block, soft_block, preference, fyi)

steps.title: Define QA message payload type
steps.description: Create TypeScript interface for Q&A channel message payload in src/relay/. This defines the shape of `data` field when `data.type === 'qa'`.

acceptance_criteria.description: QAMessagePayload interface exists with fields: { type: 'qa', questionId: string, questionText: string, answerText: string, agentName: string, agentRole: string, blockingLevel: QuestionBlockingLevel, answeredAt: string }
Type is exported from src/relay/index.ts

steps.title: Send Q&A channel message on answer
steps.description: In src/api/handlers/questions.ts, after answerQuestion() succeeds, call sendChannelMessage() to broadcast Q&A to #plan-{planId} channel. Use the relay client's channel messaging with data.type='qa' payload.

acceptance_criteria.description: After answerQuestion() in handlers/questions.ts, sendChannelMessage() is called with channel=#plan-{planId}
Message body is human-readable summary: 'Q: {question}\nA: {answer}'
Message data field contains full QAMessagePayload with all required fields
Channel ID uses plan's full UUID (not prefix), matching #plan-{plan_id} format

steps.title: Define QA message payload type (frontend)
steps.description: Add QAMessagePayload type to packages/planner-ui/src/types/relay.ts matching the backend definition.

acceptance_criteria.description: QAMessagePayload interface in types/relay.ts matches backend definition
Type guard isQAMessage(data: unknown): data is QAMessagePayload exists

steps.title: Create QAMessageCard component
steps.description: Create packages/planner-ui/src/components/QAMessageCard.tsx component that renders Q&A messages with distinct styling. Should match Mission Control design system with accent colors for blocking level badges.

acceptance_criteria.description: QAMessageCard component accepts QAMessagePayload + timestamp props
Card uses bg-bg-card with border-l-4 accent border (cyan for answered)
Shows question icon and 'QUESTION ANSWERED' header label
Displays agent name and role who asked the question
Shows blocking level badge using existing question-type-badges pattern (hard_block=error, soft_block/preference=warning, fyi=cyan)
Question text in text-secondary, answer text in text-primary with emphasis
Timestamp displayed in relative or absolute format

steps.title: Integrate QAMessageCard into MessageStream
steps.description: Modify MessageStream.tsx to detect Q&A messages via data.type === 'qa' and render QAMessageCard instead of MessageBubble. Q&A messages should span full width (not left/right aligned).

acceptance_criteria.description: MessageStream checks message.data?.type === 'qa' before rendering
Q&A messages render QAMessageCard component with full data payload
Q&A messages span full width (not aligned left/right like chat)
Normal messages continue to render as MessageBubble unchanged
Q&A messages respect date grouping and appear in chronological order

steps.title: Write unit tests for QAMessageCard
steps.description: Create test file packages/planner-ui/src/components/QAMessageCard.test.tsx with tests for rendering different blocking levels and edge cases.

acceptance_criteria.description: Tests render QAMessageCard with each blocking level (hard_block, soft_block, preference, fyi)
Tests verify all required fields are displayed (question, answer, agent, badge)
Tests verify badge colors match design system pattern

steps.title: Integration test: answer question broadcasts to channel
steps.description: Add integration test in src/api/handlers/questions.test.ts that verifies answering a question sends a channel message with correct Q&A payload.

acceptance_criteria.description: Test creates a question, answers it via POST /questions/:id/answer
Test verifies sendChannelMessage was called with #plan-{planId}
Test verifies message data contains correct QAMessagePayload fields
